parameters.content:
## DryRun twin
Builds the twin of one real person (POST /webhook/dryrun/twin, docs/CONTRACT.md 0.27), streamed step by step to the twin page: your emails with their address (connected), the meetings they were invited to, their name elsewhere (suggestions only), then facts with quotes. Nothing from a rehearsal is ever read. A step after the model drops any fact whose quote is not in its source.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ step: { step: $json.say.step, text: $json.say.text, adds: $json.say.adds }, execution_id: $execution.id, workflow_id: $workflow.id }) }}

filters.q: ={{ '(' + $('Who they are').first().json.addresses.map(a => 'from:' + a + ' OR to:' + a).join(' OR ') + ') -subject:(\"Your brief for\") -subject:(\"Your rehearsal for\")' }}

={{ (() => { const j = $('Find their meetings').first().json; const n = String(j.name || '').split('"').join('').trim(); if (n.split(' ').length < 2) return 'from:nobody@invalid.invalid'; return '"' + n + '" ' + j.addresses.map(a => '-from:' + a + ' -to:' + a).join(' ') + ' newer_than:365d -subject:(\"Your brief for\") -subject:(\"Your rehearsal for\")'; })() }}

parameters.url: ={{ (() => { const j = $('Find their meetings').first().json; return String(j.name || '').includes(' ') ? 'https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=' + encodeURIComponent('"' + j.name + '"' + (j.company ? ' "' + j.company + '"' : '')) + '&hl=en-IN&gl=IN&ceid=IN:en' : 'https://invalid.invalid'; })() }}
